text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105249-feature-new-pages/requirements.md` has been written with all required sections:

- **In scope** (1–9, numbered and testable, strictly within the brief's files-in-scope allowlist)
- **Out of scope** (1–7, numbered, explicitly excluding `.gitignore` and off-limits files)
- **Functional requirements per module** (`FR-1` through `FR-20` across Element/Scene, Editor State/Viewport/History, Tab Bar UI/Filtering/Search, Library API/Embedder Safety, Serialization/Restore/Export, App Persistence/Share Links/Collab, and Companion Docs)
- **Non-functional requirements** (`NFR-1` through `NFR-5`)
- **PII inventory** (table covering `page.id`, `page.name`, `page.viewport`, and existing collaborator metadata with sensitivity and protection details)
- **Role matrix** (role × resource × action across interactive users, view-mode users, embedder users with the tab bar disabled, collaborators, and share-link recipients)
- **Acceptance criteria** (`AC-1` through `AC-14`, each executable via `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false` or a named vitest file, honoring Gate 0 decisions on `#json=` share links and non-destructive embedder preservation with the tab bar off)
- **Open questions for HITL** (none; all Gate 0 decisions are frozen and representation trade-offs are delegated to Phase 2 architecture design per the brief)
